evidence_class: mechanism-repair development on already-burned SCORPION; not confirmation and cannot rescue RT1
motivation: RT2 prospectively supported residual-direction-specific local encoder amplification: candidate-minus-control same-residual finite sensitivity mean +0.00675242 with 95% slide-bootstrap CI [+0.00584366,+0.00773971]; candidate-minus-control residual JVP gain +0.03500708 CI [+0.03263835,+0.03747871]; matched-random JVP difference +0.02272930 CI [+0.02016778,+0.02545590]; residual-direction specificity interaction +0.01227778 CI [+0.00989669,+0.01459566]. RT3 tests whether suppressing encoder gain specifically along training-scanner post-transport residuals repairs the real-data alignment failure better than generic matched-norm smoothing.

inverse_isotropic.sensitivity_regularizer: matched-norm random directions around reference x_0

inverse_residual_tangent.sensitivity_regularizer: actual post-transport residual directions r_s=T_s^-1(x_s)-x_0 around reference x_0

capacity.architecture: identical RT1 encoder, decoder, and scanner operator family in all four arms

training.heldout_calibration: exactly RT1; heldout operator only on val slides
training.regularizer_definition: mean over known non-reference scanners and train regions of MSE(E(x_0+v),E(x_0)) / max(MSE(v,0),1e-12)
training.isotropic_direction: one fixed Gaussian unit direction per train region and known scanner, rescaled each epoch to exactly match the RMS norm of that scanner's current detached residual
training.regularizer_operator_gradient: forbidden; residual direction and norm are detached before the sensitivity term
training.rationale_for_weight: the sensitivity term is dimensionless because latent displacement is normalized by input-direction MSE; weight 1.0 is frozen and not tuned on SCORPION outcomes

evaluation.seed_handling: average seeds within fold/heldout/arm/slide before arm contrasts
evaluation.scanner_handling: average all four preregistered heldout-scanner contrasts within slide before primary inference

requirements: residual-tangent arm has lower heldout biological alignment MSE than inverse baseline: lower 95% slide-bootstrap bound of baseline-minus-residual_tangent alignment > 0
residual-tangent arm has lower heldout biological alignment MSE than isotropic smoothing: lower 95% slide-bootstrap bound of isotropic-minus-residual_tangent alignment > 0
residual-tangent arm restores advantage over no-inverse control: lower 95% slide-bootstrap bound of control-minus-residual_tangent alignment > 0
residual-tangent retrieval versus no-inverse control is noninferior: lower 95% bound of residual_tangent-minus-control top1 >= -0.02
residual-tangent known-scanner probe accuracy is lower than no-inverse control: lower 95% bound of control-minus-residual_tangent probe accuracy > 0
residual-tangent operator-only heldout transport gain has lower 95% bound > 0
residual-tangent operator-only known-scanner transport gain has lower 95% bound > 0
all four arms have equal parameter counts

secondary_mechanistic_outputs: heldout same-residual finite encoder sensitivity for all arms
heldout residual-direction JVP gain for all arms
matched-random JVP gain for all arms

interpretation_tree.targeted_beats_baseline_and_isotropic_an: supports residual-direction-specific sensitivity as a causally repairable contributor to RT1 failure
interpretation_tree.targeted_beats_baseline_but_not_isotropi: generic smoothness is sufficient; residual-direction specificity is not established as the necessary intervention
interpretation_tree.targeted_beats_isotropic_but_not_control: specific repair helps but is insufficient to restore the original real-data alignment hypothesis
interpretation_tree.targeted_does_not_beat_baseline: residual-tangent suppression does not causally repair the RT1 alignment failure under this intervention

claim_boundary: RT3 is development on the already-inspected SCORPION dataset. Even a full pass cannot retrospectively turn RT1 into a pass and cannot count as independent confirmation. A successful RT3 mechanism must be frozen and tested externally on an unseen genuinely paired scanner dataset such as McGill before any external-validity claim.
